title: Paw Patrol. Chase looks for the lost puppy.
lines: In the town of Adventure Bay there is a tall tower by the sea.
That's the Paw Patrol's Lookout tower.
Six brave puppies live there with a boy called Ryder.
Ryder is ten years old and he's the leader of the Paw Patrol.
When someone is in trouble, he calls the puppies.
And then they run to their vehicles and come to help.
Because no job is too big, and no pup is too small!
There's Chase, the police dog with his blue cap.
Skye, who can fly with her helicopter.
Rubble, the construction dog with his digger.
And Zuma, who loves the water.
One Saturday morning the puppies are playing ball on the grass.
My chicken Chickaletta has run away.
And I also saw a little lost puppy in the park.
They jump into the lift and line up in a row.
We have to find a lost puppy in the park.
Chase, you have the best nose.
And Skye, you look from above with your helicopter.
The puppies slide down the slide to their vehicles.
He smells flowers, and grass, and a cheese sandwich.
And then he smells something else.
Past the pond, under the bridge, all the way to a big bush.
I can see something moving in the bush!
There sits a little brown puppy with white ears.
Hello, little one, says Chase very gently.
My name is Pip, it sobs.
I was playing with a butterfly and then my owner was gone.
Chase sits down next to Pip.
He gives her a little lick on the nose.
We're going to find your owner, he says.
Who has lost a little brown puppy with white ears?
On the other side of the park a girl jumps up.
She runs over to them and hugs her puppy.
Pip wags her tail so hard that her whole body wiggles.
But do you know what Pip still needs?
A collar with her name and your phone number.
Then everyone can help if she gets lost again.
Out of the same bush walks a chicken.
Mayor Goodway comes running up and takes her chicken in her arms.
Two lost friends found in one day!
Whenever you're in trouble, just call.
That evening all the puppies get an extra dog biscuit.
And Chase gets two, because he had the best nose.
